content:
- Model consistently overestimates early in the 30-day horizon, especially in the first 5–7 days, then underestimates later — adjust downward in early forecast periods.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., +5–10% from prior day), model overshoots and fails to correct — reduce forecast peak by 2–5% in subsequent days.
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day horizon; model often fails to reflect this — apply a 1–3% downward bias toward end of forecast period.
- Sentiment history is uniformly neutral (0.00) — no sentiment-driven adjustment needed; model should not react to sentiment signals.
- Forecast error is symmetric around 70–72 range — model is biased toward higher prices; apply a 1–3% downward correction to mean forecast.
- Lagged price movements (e.g., 3–5 day delays) are not captured — model should be tuned to reflect 3–5 day momentum decay.
